_ORIGIN: shape of the update-gate config used in a KMP calling app; ids are placeholders, not production values
_PURPOSE: Remote Config param `remote` (type JSON) — edit the EXISTING value in BOTH Firebase projects (Android and iOS). Delete the _ORIGIN/_PURPOSE/_RULES keys before pasting.
_RULES: allowedIds empty or missing = feature OFF for every user
versions are the integer build number N (CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION), never the 2026.x.y name — the shape guard ignores a different segment count
resting value min N / latest N only after the store serves N; raise latest (prompt) or min (force) after rollout
storeUrl: Play listing on Android, TestFlight link on iOS
